items.name: mascot-master-sheet
items.prompt: Create a complete mascot master sheet: hero pose, front, three-quarter, side, back, construction notes, signature propeller hat details, scarf, bell, coat pattern, and eight derpy expressions.

items.name: logo-system
items.prompt: Create a Borgi logo system board with horizontal wordmark, icon-only mark, monochrome versions, app icon, favicon, safe area, and minimum-size examples.

items.name: design-system
items.prompt: Create a comprehensive Borgi UI design system board showing color, typography, iconography, buttons, inputs, cards, tabs, badges, charts, shadows, radius, spacing, and mascot usage.

items.name: landing-page
items.prompt: Design the desktop landing page with header, hero, product preview, features, how it works, use cases, testimonials, pricing preview, FAQ, final CTA, and footer. Borgi points at a booking calendar.

items.name: features-page
items.prompt: Design a features page for booking, calendar, reminders, customers, staff, branches, reports, feedback, and integrations with realistic product screenshots.

items.name: pricing-page
items.prompt: Design a pricing page with monthly-yearly toggle, four plan cards, comparison table, add-ons, FAQ, and Borgi counting coins incorrectly.

items.name: sign-in
items.prompt: Design a responsive sign-in page with email, password, Google, LINE, forgot password, security reassurance, and a subtle Borgi welcome illustration.

items.name: onboarding-flow
items.prompt: Design a multi-step onboarding flow for business profile, branch, service, staff, hours, booking policy, notifications, and publish success.

items.name: booking-landing
items.prompt: Design the mobile-first public booking landing page with business profile, cover, branch, hours, services preview, policy, and start booking CTA.

items.name: service-date-time
items.prompt: Design three coordinated mobile booking screens for service selection, date selection, and available time slots.

items.name: summary-success
items.prompt: Design mobile booking summary, payment or deposit, and booking success screens with reference number, add to calendar, and manage booking.

items.name: dashboard
items.prompt: Design the admin dashboard with revenue, appointments, no-show, returning customers, revenue trend, booking density, follow-up queue, recent activity, and restrained Borgi greeting.

items.name: today
items.prompt: Design the Today operations screen with appointment timeline, check-in, waiting, in-progress, completed, no-show, payment status, and quick actions.

items.name: calendar
items.prompt: Design the week calendar with staff and service color coding, drag-and-drop appointment cards, current-time line, filters, detail drawer, and reminder panel.

items.name: appointments
items.prompt: Design appointment list, filters, bulk actions, create booking flow, and detailed appointment drawer with customer, service, time, payment, reminder history, and actions.

items.name: customers
items.prompt: Design customer list and customer detail views with booking history, lifetime value, no-show count, notes, preferences, consent, tags, and communication timeline.

items.name: operations
items.prompt: Design coordinated service, staff, branch, resource, working-hours, and leave management screens.

items.name: communication
items.prompt: Design reminder queue, follow-up, notification templates for LINE email SMS push, variables, live preview, retries, and delivery log.

items.name: reports
items.prompt: Design analytics screens for revenue, booking, no-show, retention, staff, service, branch, and notification performance.

items.name: settings
items.prompt: Design settings for organization, roles, permission matrix, integrations, API, webhook, billing, usage, branding, security, audit log, and data export.

items.name: error-states
items.prompt: Create a coordinated system-state set for 401, 403, 404, 500, maintenance, offline, and no internet. Use humorous propeller-hat situations while keeping actions clear.

items.name: empty-success-failure
items.prompt: Create a coordinated illustration pack for empty bookings, customers, services, staff, search results, payment success/failure, reminder sent/failed, and import success/failure.
